name: Bokio MCP
author: straycatse
description: Connects to one Bokio company for invoices, bookkeeping and SIE exports. Requires credentials; read-only by default, with writes available through explicit opt-in.

quality.reason: Source review only; no runtime execution or full rubric assessment. Requires a private integration token/company ID or OAuth. Listed tools are a read-only selection; BOKIO_ALLOW_WRITES enables additional mutating tools. Mock fixtures are not proof of real access. Bank payments need provider approval, and commercial costs are unverified.
